text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, everyone, for 
participating today.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Thank YOU so much!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: How did it feel singing together with us?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: "That was so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, this isn't the end. Are your 
heart rates and body temperatures rising, 
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! The hype is reaching its peak!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: How are things over at Stage B~?

text_block_list.name: Stage B Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good! Things are heating up over 
here too!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Here we go, everyone! On to the 
next song!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea concerts could be this much 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um... Hello-san!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Is something wrong? Is there an issue 
with the stage?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No. That's not it. There's something I 
want to tell you directly.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I end up as a 
backup dancer, I will keep working hard to 
become the center.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because I realized that there are so many 
fans waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I will always express my gratitude with a 
smile, no matter what. —Thank you all so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. We fans are always watching over 
all of you, you know."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Phew~... I'm beat~. Who's up next on 
stage...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: It's my turn to tag in, Falcon-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, passing the baton over to you! Go 
rock the whole venue for us!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yep!

The girls exchanged high fives and took 
turns running up onto the stage.

The stage that day was filled with 
brilliance all day long—
